The '''Ghost Ship of Veragi''' was the name eventually given to a [[Starship/Legends|starship]]<ref name="SWTOR" /> that shared it with the [[Veragi system/Legends|Veragi system]], a part of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Veragi sector/Legends|Veragi sector]] situated on the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Veragi Trade Route/Legends|Veragi Trade Route]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> The ship was equipped with a prototype [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloaking device]] that at one point malfunctioned, causing the vessel to periodically become invisible. That fact led to the rise of a legend about the craft that claimed it was a [[ghost ship]], with reports claiming sightings along Outer Rim [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] routes for [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] prior to<ref name="SWTOR" /> approximately [[3643 BBY]].<ref name="Date">Per the reasoning [[Template:TOR_dates|here]], Act I of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' takes place around [[3643 BBY]]. Since players of ''The Old Republic'' can assign their companions on the mission "Specter in Space" independently of the main class storyline at any point during the game, the mission must take place at some point around 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref>

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
Around that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], an individual affiliated with one of the sides in the ongoing [[Sith Wars/Legends|struggle]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] sent a companion to investigate the Ghost Ship of Veragi. The companion boarded the vessel, encountering no [[Ghost (folklore)/Legends|ghosts]] in the process, and discovered the cloaking device.<ref name="SWTOR" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Ghost Ship of Veragi was mentioned in an Investigation Crew Skill mission of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[BioWare]], though the information regarding the mission's outcome was later removed from the game.<ref name="SWTOR" />
